body:
Implements the user's C choice (position plus orientation) as a validated local pose chart, and separates RLS feature dimensions from Gaussian state dimensions so a six-dimensional pose block does not change existing RLS features. Adds the requested local CPU development configuration while preserving the formal architecture and schedule protocols.

Stacked on draft PR #15; no integration-branch merge is included. Production code is fixed at 188f9fc9aa17bf38f973ee00f04e0b2f148f4ca3. The final documentation commit retains raw review scripts, results and source-bound test records under docs/reviews/pc_a/pose_local_dev_2026-09-13/.

Validation: 871 tests passed at b33992da1bd775f180d915e80b7e7746546adbd9. The first independent review found a DST-fold epoch comparison defect and oversized invalid quaternion handling; both were fixed. At final code 188f9fc, 62 targeted tests and a separate reviewer's 116 independent checks passed. The full 871-test matrix was not rerun at that final SHA. Ruff passed; scoped mypy passed with the third-party missing-stub diagnostic excluded, as documented.

This delivers local geometry and development configuration only. Real pose observations and calibration, measurement reference binding, native six-operation supervision, model trainers and the continuous action loop remain open. No model training or paid compute was run; the budget configuration is not yet an enforcing trainer. The two reviews cover this implementation, not unified scientific acceptance.
title: Add local pose state and small-budget development configuration
